post.description:
Register a new user account.

The request body is validated by the :class:`RegisterUserRequest`
Pydantic model (including password complexity rules).  The
:class:`AuthService` then:
    1. Checks for duplicate emails (409 Conflict if found).
    2. Hashes the password.
    3. Creates the user record.
    4. Issues JWT access and refresh tokens.

The first user to register becomes an administrator in non-production
environments only; in production the ADMIN role is granted solely via the
bootstrap settings.

Args:
    payload: Validated request body with ``full_name``, ``email``,
        and ``password``.
    session: Database session (injected via :func:`get_session`).

Returns:
    An :class:`AuthResponse` with the user data and JWT tokens.

Authenticate a user and return JWT tokens.

The :class:`AuthService` looks up the user by email, verifies the
password, and issues JWT tokens on success.  The shared Redis client
backs the failed-login limiter, so repeat wrong passwords for one
address eventually return a 429 instead of a 401.

Args:
    payload: Validated request body with ``email`` and ``password``.
    session: Database session (injected via :func:`get_session`).
    redis_client: Shared :class:`RedisClient` (injected via
        :func:`get_redis_client`).

Returns:
    An :class:`AuthResponse` with the user data and JWT tokens.

Raises:
    HTTPException(401): If the email or password is invalid.
    HTTPException(429): If the address is temporarily locked out.

Exchange a refresh token for a new access/refresh pair.

Args:
    payload: Request body containing the ``refresh_token``.
    session: Database session (injected via :func:`get_session`).

Returns:
    A :class:`TokenResponse` with the new token pair.

Raises:
    HTTPException(401): If the refresh token is invalid or expired.

Log out the user and invalidate the refresh token.

The refresh token's ``jti`` is stored in a Redis denylist with a TTL
matching its remaining lifetime.  After a successful logout the
token can no longer be used to obtain new access tokens (via
``/auth/refresh``), and any access token sharing a revoked ``jti``
is rejected by :func:`get_current_user`.

Args:
    payload: Request body containing the ``refresh_token``.
    session: Database session (injected via :func:`get_session`).

Returns:
    A :class:`TokenResponse` with a success message.

Raises:
    HTTPException(401): If the refresh token is invalid.

get.description:
Return the authenticated user's identity.

The identity comes from the validated JWT access token (via
:func:`require_db_user`), which rejects API-key (``SERVICE``)
identities since they have no database row.

Args:

Returns:

post.description:
Clear cached data belonging to the authenticated user.

Deletes their user-scoped AI chat responses and their reverse-proxy
response cache entries.  Their conversation histories survive unless
``include_conversations=true`` is passed.  The operation is scoped to the
caller — no other user's keys and no global state (rate-limit counters,
token denylist) are touched.

Returns:
    ``{"status": "ok", "user_id": ..., "cleared": {...}}`` with
    per-category deletion counts.  ``cleared.conversations_cleared`` is
    ``0`` whenever ``include_conversations`` is false.

Raises:
    HTTPException(401): If the request is not authenticated.
    HTTPException(403): If an API-key identity calls the endpoint.

get.description:
Return the public remote app configuration.

Layout::

    {
      "maintenance": {"enabled": bool, "message": str},
      "versions": {"min_supported": str, "recommended": str, "store_url": str},
      "features": {"medications": bool, ...},
      "announcements": [{"title": str, "body": str, "level": str}]
    }

A short ``Cache-Control`` and a strong ``ETag`` let clients revalidate
cheaply; a bodyless ``304`` is returned when ``If-None-Match`` matches.

post.description:
Create a new objective for the authenticated user.

The request body is validated by the :class:`RegisterObjectiveRequest`
Pydantic model.  The :class:`ObjectiveService` then:
    1. Validates that the ``due_date`` is not in the past.
    2. Creates the objective record, associating it with the
       authenticated user.

Args:
    payload: Validated request body with ``title``, ``description``,
        and ``due_date``.
    current_user: The authenticated user's identity (injected via
        :func:`require_db_user`).  Must contain an ``id`` key.
    session: Database session (injected via :func:`get_session`).

Returns:
    An :class:`ObjectiveResponse` with the created objective's data.

Raises:
    HTTPException(400): If ``due_date`` is in the past.
    HTTPException(401): If the user is not authenticated.

Renew an objective's roadmap for the next 7-day window.

The roadmap always covers only 7 days.  Once that window elapses,
the owner (or an administrator) calls this endpoint to generate the
next 7-day roadmap, using the previous roadmap as context.

Args:
    objective_id: ID of the objective whose roadmap will be renewed.
    current_user: The authenticated user's identity (injected via
        :func:`get_current_user`).
    session: Database session (injected via :func:`get_session`).

Returns:
    An :class:`ObjectiveResponse` with the updated roadmap.

Raises:
    HTTPException(401): If the user is not authenticated.
    HTTPException(403): If the user does not own the objective and
        is not an administrator.
    HTTPException(404): If the objective does not exist.
    HTTPException(409): If the 7-day window has not elapsed yet.

Run the dedicated objective-assistant flow for goal creation.

The conversation history is kept in the cache so the assistant can

the cached conversation is deleted.

patch.description:
Update the signed-in user's own profile (currently just the name).

The e-mail is intentionally not editable here — it is the login
identifier and the unique account key, so changing it is an identity
change rather than a profile edit.

Args:
    payload: Validated request body with the new ``full_name``.
    current_user: The authenticated caller's identity (injected).
    session: Database session (injected via :func:`get_session`).

Returns:
    A :class:`UserProfileResponse` carrying the refreshed identity, in
    the same shape as ``GET /auth/me`` so a client can replace its
    cached profile with it.

Raises:
    HTTPException(404): If the caller no longer exists.

Rotate the signed-in user's own password.

The current password must be supplied and must verify against the
stored hash.  On success every refresh token issued before the change
is invalidated, so all sessions must sign in again with the new
password.

Args:
    payload: Validated request body with ``current_password`` and
        ``new_password``.
    current_user: The authenticated caller's identity (injected).
    session: Database session (injected via :func:`get_session`).

Returns:
    A :class:`ActionResponse` with a success message.

Raises:
    HTTPException(400): If the current password is wrong, or the new
        one is identical to it.  Deliberately not 401 — see
        :meth:`app.services.user_service.UserService.change_password`.
    HTTPException(404): If the caller no longer exists.

delete.description:
Forward an incoming request to a downstream service.

The ``service_name`` path parameter captures everything after
``/proxy/`` (e.g. ``ai/chat`` → ``service_name="ai/chat"``).  The
first segment (``ai``) is used to look up the downstream service
configuration; the remaining segments form the path on the
downstream service.

Flow:
    1. Look up the downstream service by name.
    2. Read and validate the request body (payload size check).
    3. For GET/HEAD requests, check the Redis cache for a hit.
    4. Build the downstream URL and forward headers (stripping
       sensitive headers like ``Authorization`` and ``Cookie``).
    5. Send the request via ``httpx.AsyncClient``.
    6. Cache the response for GET/HEAD requests.
    7. Return the downstream response to the client.

Args:
    request: The incoming :class:`Request`.
    service_name: The path parameter capturing the service name
        and sub-path (e.g. ``"ai/chat"``).
    redis_client: Redis client for caching (injected).
    current_user: The authenticated user's identity (injected).

Returns:
    A :class:`Response` mirroring the downstream service's response.

Raises:
    HTTPException(404): If the service name is not configured.
    HTTPException(413): If the request body exceeds ``max_payload_bytes``.
    HTTPException(502): If the downstream service is unreachable.

The previous turns held with the same agent are replayed to the model, so

Run the general-agent flow: chat with access to the user's objectives.

Delegates to :class:`AgentOrchestratorService` in conversational-only
mode, so behaviour (personalization, context, cached history) is
unchanged while the implementation is shared with the tool layer.

starting a fresh conversation on the next chat request.

post.description:
Translate the user's message into a reply and an optional action.

The returned ``action`` is a validated, whitelisted structure; the
backend does not execute it.  ``action`` is ``null`` when the message
needed no action or the model returned something outside the whitelist —
the ``reply`` is still returned in that case.

Two actions read the caller's own objectives:

* ``WHAT_IS_PENDING_TODAY`` is answered from the database.
* ``MARK_DAY_COMPLETED`` is owner-checked and returned for the client to
  confirm; the day is only written once the client calls
  ``PATCH /api/v1/objectives/{objective_id}/roadmap/days/{day_id}``.

Args:
    payload: Validated request body carrying ``user_message``.
    current_user: The authenticated identity (injected via
        :func:`require_db_user`).  Actions are performed on the
        caller's own device and read their own roadmap, so an API-key
        identity is rejected.
    session: Request-scoped database session used to resolve the
        roadmap actions.

Returns:
    A :class:`DeviceCommandResponse` with ``reply`` and ``action``.

Raises:
    HTTPException(401): If the request is not authenticated.
    HTTPException(403): If an API-key identity calls the endpoint.
    HTTPException(422): If the request body is invalid.

Return a portable JSON bundle of the caller's entire account.

The bundle (content-type ``application/json``) is meant to be consumed by
the user, not machines: it is a plain, pre-serialized document with no
secrets — neither the password hash nor any purchase-token hash is ever
included.

The endpoint is throttled per user on top of the global per-IP bucket; a
caller that exhausts the hourly budget receives a 429.

Args:
    session: Database session (injected).
    redis_client: Shared :class:`RedisClient`, backer of the per-user
        export limiter (injected).
    current_user: The authenticated database-backed identity (injected).

Returns:

delete.description:
Hard-delete the caller's account and all owned data.

``password`` must match the account's current password: a leaked access
token alone must never be able to wipe an account.  A wrong password is a
400 (never an ambiguous 401), mirroring the password-change route.

All owned rows and Redis keys are removed in a single transaction; when
the account has a Play subscription, the response carries Google's
account-managed subscription-cancellation URL so the user can stop
billing without contacting support.

Args:
    payload: The account password.
    session: Database session (injected).
    redis_client: Shared :class:`RedisClient` for the post-transaction
        Redis purge (injected).
    current_user: The authenticated database-backed identity (injected).

Returns:
    A confirmation message, plus the Play subscription-management URL
    when a subscription exists.

Raises:
    HTTPException(400): If the password does not verify.

post.description:
Process the deletion request form.

With both ``email`` and a matching ``password`` the account is wiped
immediately (identity proof).  Wrong credentials stay on the form with a
400 message — never a redirect that could drop the user's typed input.

With ``email`` only, a pending :class:`DeletionRequest` is queued so an
operator can follow up out-of-band.

get.description: Return minimal public service information for the base URL.

Combined liveness/readiness probe used by orchestrators and probes.

Performs a real dependency check on every call:
    - Runs ``SELECT 1`` against the database (2s timeout).
    - Pings Redis via a fresh connection (2s timeout).

Returns ``{"status": "ok", "db": "ok", "redis": "ok"}`` with HTTP 200
when both dependencies are reachable.  If either check fails, the
body reports the failing components as ``"error"`` and the response
status is **503** so Render's health check marks the instance
unhealthy.

This endpoint is excluded from the auth middleware (public) and is
fully exempted from rate limiting by :class:`RateLimitMiddleware`.

The closed set of tools the agent may propose.

The first block is executed **by the backend** after confirmation (or
resolved server-side, for ``SHOW_AGENDA``); the second block mirrors the
existing device-command whitelist and is returned to the app for **local**
execution.

AgentChatRequest.title: AgentChatRequest
AgentChatRequest.description:
Body for ``POST /agents/chat``.

``message`` and the legacy ``user_message`` are accepted interchangeably.

AgentChatResponse.title: AgentChatResponse
AgentChatResponse.description: Result of one orchestrated agent turn.

AgentGroupResponse.title: AgentGroupResponse
AgentGroupResponse.description: One entry of the audience-group catalog (``GET /agent-groups``).

AuthResponse.title: AuthResponse
AuthResponse.description:
Response body returned by both ``/auth/register`` and ``/auth/login``.

Attributes:
    user: A dictionary containing the user's ``id``, ``full_name``,
        ``email``, and ``role``.
    access_token: A short-lived JWT access token.
    refresh_token: A long-lived JWT refresh token.

BillCreate.title: BillCreate
BillCreate.description: Request body for creating a bill.

BillResponse.title: BillResponse
BillResponse.description: Response body for a single bill.

BillUpdate.title: BillUpdate
BillUpdate.description: Request body for patching a bill (all fields optional).

BillsSummaryResponse.title: BillsSummaryResponse
BillsSummaryResponse.description: Aggregated bill figures for the month.

BlockCreate.title: BlockCreate
BlockCreate.description: Request body for blocking another user.

BlockResponse.title: BlockResponse
BlockResponse.description: One blocking relationship from the caller's perspective.

BudgetResponse.title: BudgetResponse
BudgetResponse.description: Response body for a single budget.

BudgetSet.title: BudgetSet
BudgetSet.description: Request body to set (upsert) a monthly category budget.

BudgetStatusResponse.title: BudgetStatusResponse
BudgetStatusResponse.description: One budget compared against the month's spending in its category.

CacheFlushBreakdown.title: CacheFlushBreakdown
CacheFlushBreakdown.description:
Per-category counts of the keys removed by a cache flush.

``conversations_cleared`` is always ``0`` unless the caller opted in with
``include_conversations=true``.

CacheFlushResponse.title: CacheFlushResponse
CacheFlushResponse.description:
Result of flushing the caller's user-scoped cache.

The flush never touches other users' keys nor global state such as
rate-limit counters or the token denylist.

CardCreate.title: CardCreate
CardCreate.description: Request body for adding a card to a deck.

CardResponse.title: CardResponse
CardResponse.description: Response body for a single flashcard with its SM-2 state.

CardUpdate.title: CardUpdate
CardUpdate.description: Request body for patching a card (all fields optional).

ChatCompletionRequest.title: ChatCompletionRequest
ChatCompletionRequest.description: Request body for the AI chat completion endpoint.

ChatCompletionResponse.title: ChatCompletionResponse
ChatCompletionResponse.description:
Response body returned by the AI chat completion endpoint.

``assistant_message`` is the answer with the personalization marker
stripped.  ``why`` (short reasons) and ``sources`` (the memory keys /
group / sub-agent slugs that influenced the reply) come from the model's
``[personalization]`` marker and default to empty when the model did not
emit one.

ChecklistCategory.title: ChecklistCategory
ChecklistCategory.description: The curated checklist buckets requested by the product.

ChecklistCreate.title: ChecklistCreate
ChecklistCreate.description: Request body for creating a checklist.

ChecklistItemCreate.title: ChecklistItemCreate
ChecklistItemCreate.description: Request body for adding an item to a checklist.

ChecklistItemResponse.title: ChecklistItemResponse
ChecklistItemResponse.description: Response body for a single checklist item.

ChecklistItemUpdate.title: ChecklistItemUpdate
ChecklistItemUpdate.description: Request body for patching a checklist item.

ChecklistResponse.title: ChecklistResponse
ChecklistResponse.description: Response body for a checklist with its items.

ChecklistUpdate.title: ChecklistUpdate
ChecklistUpdate.description: Request body for patching a checklist.

ComposeMessageAction.title: ComposeMessageAction
ComposeMessageAction.description:
Open a messaging app with a draft addressed to a contact.

**Prepares only.**  The user still presses send; this action never
sends a message.

ConfirmationResponse.title: ConfirmationResponse
ConfirmationResponse.description: Result of confirming (or un-confirming) a report.

ConsentRecordSchema.title: ConsentRecordSchema
ConsentRecordSchema.description: One row of the consent log.

ConsentUpdateRequest.title: ConsentUpdateRequest
ConsentUpdateRequest.description:
Grant (or re-acknowledge) one consent type.

Attributes:
    type: One of ``terms``, ``privacy``, ``microphone``, ``contacts``,
        ``location`` or ``learning``.
    version: The document version being accepted.  Optional — when
        omitted the currently configured version (see
        ``Settings.consent_versions``) is used.

ConsentWithdrawalResponse.title: ConsentWithdrawalResponse
ConsentWithdrawalResponse.description: Result of withdrawing one consent type via ``DELETE /me/consents/{type}``.

ConversationClearResponse.title: ConversationClearResponse
ConversationClearResponse.description:
Response body returned after clearing a chat conversation.

Attributes:
    agent_id: The agent whose conversation was cleared.
    cleared: Always ``True``; a missing agent yields ``404`` instead.

CreateCalendarEventParams.title: CreateCalendarEventParams
CreateCalendarEventParams.description:
Parameters for :attr:`DeviceActionType.CREATE_CALENDAR_EVENT`.

``start_iso`` must be an ISO-8601 timestamp.  A value without an offset
is read as UTC, matching how the rest of the app stores timestamps.
``end_iso``, when given, must be strictly after ``start_iso``.

DataExportResponse.title: DataExportResponse
DataExportResponse.description:
A portable, machine-readable export of everything tied to the account.

The stable top-level sections are typed; the per-module row arrays
(``objectives``, ``memories``, ``productivity``, …) are pre-serialized
JSON-safe documents, so they are declared as plain mappings while still
surfacing a non-empty schema in the OpenAPI document.  ``extra="allow"``
keeps any future section from being silently dropped by the response
model.

DeckCreate.title: DeckCreate
DeckCreate.description: Request body for creating a flashcard deck.

DeckResponse.title: DeckResponse
DeckResponse.description: Response body for a deck, including its card count.

DeckUpdate.title: DeckUpdate
DeckUpdate.description: Request body for patching a deck (all fields optional).

user_message.title: User Message
user_message.description: The user's request, in their own words.

message_id.title: Message Id
message_id.description: Stable identifier of this turn, persisted server-side. Echo it back in `POST /api/v1/ai/feedback` to report the answer.

action.title: Action
action.description: One validated, whitelisted action, or null. The backend never executes it. When present the client must respect `requires_confirmation` and `prepares_only`.

DeviceCommandResponse.title: DeviceCommandResponse
DeviceCommandResponse.description:
Reply plus the single action the client may carry out.

``action`` is ``None`` when the message needed no action or the model's
output fell outside the whitelist.  ``reply`` is always present.

DialAction.title: DialAction
DialAction.description:
Open the dialer with a contact ready to call.

**Prepares only.**  The user still presses the call button; this action
never places a call.

DialParams.title: DialParams
DialParams.description:
Parameters for :attr:`DeviceActionType.DIAL`.

At least one of ``contact_name``/``phone`` is required, so the app always
knows whom to dial.  The phone is normalised server-side to digits with
an optional leading ``+`` (``+55 (11) 99999-9999`` becomes
``+5511999999999``); anything that does not leave 6–15 digits rejects the
whole action.

DraftCreate.title: DraftCreate
DraftCreate.description: Request body for creating/editing a draft complaint.

DraftGenerateRequest.title: DraftGenerateRequest
DraftGenerateRequest.description: Request body to generate a draft from a report using the AI.

DraftResponse.title: DraftResponse
DraftResponse.description: A draft complaint.  It is a template the user must review and send.

DraftUpdate.title: DraftUpdate
DraftUpdate.description: Request body for patching a draft complaint.

EmergencyBlock.title: EmergencyBlock
EmergencyBlock.description:
Machine-readable emergency resources attached to a chat reply.

``active`` is ``True`` only on a crisis/emergency turn; ``contacts`` then
lists the Brazilian helplines (CVV 188, SAMU 192, Bombeiros 193, Polícia
190, Ligue 180) so the app can render tappable call actions.  On an
ordinary turn ``active`` is ``False`` and ``contacts`` is empty.

EmergencyContact.title: EmergencyContact
EmergencyContact.description: One helpline surfaced when a crisis/emergency is detected.

ExpenseCreate.title: ExpenseCreate
ExpenseCreate.description: Request body for creating an expense.

ExpenseResponse.title: ExpenseResponse
ExpenseResponse.description: Response body for a single expense.

ExpenseUpdate.title: ExpenseUpdate
ExpenseUpdate.description: Request body for patching an expense (all fields optional).

ExportedSubscription.title: ExportedSubscription
ExportedSubscription.description: The optional Play subscription embedded in a data-export bundle.

ExportedUser.title: ExportedUser
ExportedUser.description:
The account record embedded in a data-export bundle.

Deliberately excludes the password hash and any purchase-token hash.

ExportedUserAgent.title: ExportedUserAgent
ExportedUserAgent.description: The optional personalization profile embedded in a data-export bundle.

FeedbackReason.title: FeedbackReason
FeedbackReason.description: Coarse reasons a user can attach to an AI answer report.

FinanceSummaryResponse.title: FinanceSummaryResponse
FinanceSummaryResponse.description:
Monthly financial overview for the caller.

The ``disclaimer`` states plainly that this is a record of the user's own
numbers, not financial advice.

FlagCreate.title: FlagCreate
FlagCreate.description: Request body for flagging a report.

FocusSessionCreate.title: FocusSessionCreate
FocusSessionCreate.description: Request body for starting a focus session.

FocusSessionResponse.title: FocusSessionResponse
FocusSessionResponse.description: Response body for a single focus session.

FocusSessionUpdate.title: FocusSessionUpdate
FocusSessionUpdate.description: Request body for patching a focus session (e.g. to finish it).

GeneralAgentConversationClearResponse.title: GeneralAgentConversationClearResponse
GeneralAgentConversationClearResponse.description: Response body returned when the conversation history is cleared.

GeneralAgentRequest.title: GeneralAgentRequest
GeneralAgentRequest.description: Request body for the general agent endpoint.

GeneralAgentResponse.title: GeneralAgentResponse
GeneralAgentResponse.description:
Response body returned by the general agent endpoint.

``why`` (short reasons) and ``sources`` (the memory keys / group /
sub-agent slugs that influenced the reply) come from the model's
``[personalization]`` marker and default to empty when the model did not
emit one.

GoogleVerifyRequest.title: GoogleVerifyRequest
GoogleVerifyRequest.description:
Request body for ``POST /billing/google/verify``.

The client sends the Play product id and the purchase token it obtained
from the Billing library; the server verifies the token against Google
before granting anything.

HabitCheckInRequest.title: HabitCheckInRequest
HabitCheckInRequest.description: Optional body for a habit check-in (defaults to the user's today).

HabitCreate.title: HabitCreate
HabitCreate.description: Request body for creating a habit.

HabitResponse.title: HabitResponse
HabitResponse.description: Response body for a habit with its streak and recent check-ins.

IncomeCreate.title: IncomeCreate
IncomeCreate.description: Request body for creating an income.

IncomeResponse.title: IncomeResponse
IncomeResponse.description: Response body for a single income.

IncomeUpdate.title: IncomeUpdate
IncomeUpdate.description: Request body for patching an income (all fields optional).

IntakeCreate.title: IntakeCreate
IntakeCreate.description:
Request body for logging a medication intake.

``status`` defaults to ``taken`` because the most common client action is
"I took it now"; a caller may also record ``skipped`` (with an optional
note) or a ``pending`` scheduled dose.  The scheduled instant is accepted
either as ``scheduled_at`` (legacy) or ``scheduled_for`` (preferred); naive
datetimes are interpreted in the user's ``/me/agent`` timezone.

IntakeResponse.title: IntakeResponse
IntakeResponse.description: Response body for a single intake.

IntakeStatus.title: IntakeStatus
IntakeStatus.description: Lifecycle of a single medication intake.

LogEntryCreate.title: LogEntryCreate
LogEntryCreate.description: Request body for creating a log entry.

LogEntryResponse.title: LogEntryResponse
LogEntryResponse.description:
Response body for a single log entry.

``metadata`` maps to the ORM's ``metadata_`` attribute (the name
``metadata`` is reserved by SQLAlchemy's declarative base).

LogEntryUpdate.title: LogEntryUpdate
LogEntryUpdate.description: Request body for patching a log entry (all fields optional).

LogKind.title: LogKind
LogKind.description: The three log kinds the product supports.

LogKindReport.title: LogKindReport
LogKindReport.description: Aggregated figures for one log kind.

LogReportResponse.title: LogReportResponse
LogReportResponse.description: Report for a date range, grouped by kind and category.

LoginRequest.title: LoginRequest
LoginRequest.description:
Request body for the ``POST /auth/login`` endpoint.

Attributes:
    email: The user's email address.
    password: The user's plaintext password.

        The upper bound matches :attr:`RegisterUserRequest.password`.  A
        stored password can never exceed 128 characters, so a longer one
        is rejected with a 422 before it reaches the expensive PBKDF2
        hash — without this, a single request could hand the server a
        multi-megabyte "password" and tie up a CPU core for seconds.

LogoutRequest.title: LogoutRequest
LogoutRequest.description:
Request body for the ``POST /auth/logout`` endpoint.

Attributes:
    refresh_token: The refresh token to revoke.
    access_token: Optional access token to revoke as well, so the
        current session ends immediately.

MarkDayCompletedAction.title: MarkDayCompletedAction
MarkDayCompletedAction.description:
Mark a roadmap day as completed.

The server verifies that both ids belong to the caller before returning
this action.  The day is **not** marked here: the client confirms with
the user and then calls
``PATCH /api/v1/objectives/{objective_id}/roadmap/days/{day_id}``, which
performs the owner-checked write.  Marking it inside this request would
make ``requires_confirmation`` meaningless.

MarkDayCompletedParams.title: MarkDayCompletedParams
MarkDayCompletedParams.description:
Parameters for :attr:`DeviceActionType.MARK_DAY_COMPLETED`.

The ids must come from the data block the server supplies; the service
re-checks ownership of both before returning the action, so a model
cannot point at another user's roadmap.

schedule_times.title: Schedule Times
schedule_times.description: Horários locais ('HH:MM') em que a dose é devida, no fuso do usuário.

start_date.title: Start Date
start_date.description: Primeiro dia em que o horário vale.

end_date.title: End Date
end_date.description: Último dia do horário (null = sem fim).

MedicationCreate.title: MedicationCreate
MedicationCreate.description: Request body for creating a medication.

MedicationResponse.title: MedicationResponse
MedicationResponse.description: Response body for a single medication.

MedicationUpdate.title: MedicationUpdate
MedicationUpdate.description: Request body for patching a medication (all fields optional).

MemoryUpdate.title: MemoryUpdate
MemoryUpdate.description:
Request body for ``PATCH /me/memories/{key}``.

At least one of ``value``/``enabled`` must be provided.

MessagingApp.title: MessagingApp
MessagingApp.description:
Which messaging app a draft is prepared in.

The message is **never sent by the backend** — see this module's
docstring.

MindMapNode.title: MindMapNode
MindMapNode.description: A node in the generated mind map.

MindMapRequest.title: MindMapRequest
MindMapRequest.description: Request body to generate a mind map for a topic.

MindMapResponse.title: MindMapResponse
MindMapResponse.description: Generated mind map with a disclaimer.

NavigateAction.title: NavigateAction
NavigateAction.description: Start turn-by-turn navigation to a destination.

NoParams.title: NoParams
NoParams.description: Empty parameter set, for actions that take no arguments.

NoteCreate.title: NoteCreate
NoteCreate.description: Request body for creating a note.

NoteResponse.title: NoteResponse
NoteResponse.description: Response body for a single note.

NoteUpdate.title: NoteUpdate
NoteUpdate.description: Request body for patching a note.

ObjectiveAssistantRequest.title: ObjectiveAssistantRequest
ObjectiveAssistantRequest.description: Request body for the objective-assistant endpoint.

ObjectiveAssistantResponse.title: ObjectiveAssistantResponse
ObjectiveAssistantResponse.description:
Response body returned by the objective-assistant endpoint.

Attributes:
    assistant_message: The assistant's reply for this turn.  When the
        model returned a complete objective but its due date could not be
        parsed, this is a request for the user to confirm the date, and
        ``created_objective`` stays ``None``.
    created_objective: The objective that was auto-registered, or
        ``None`` when the assistant only asked a question (or the draft
        was not usable yet).

ObjectiveResponse.title: ObjectiveResponse
ObjectiveResponse.description:
Response body returned by ``POST /objectives/register``.

The objective is the user's general goal.  The roadmap lives inside
it as the ``roadmap`` markdown plus the per-day ``days`` records,
each carrying its basic meta / minimum objective.

Attributes:
    id: The database-generated objective ID.
    title: The objective's title.
    description: The objective's description (may be ``None``).
    roadmap: The AI-generated roadmap for the objective (may be
        ``None`` until generated).
    roadmap_updated_at: Timestamp of the last roadmap generation
        (may be ``None`` until generated).
    due_date: The objective's deadline.
    user_id: The ID of the user who owns this objective.
    days: The roadmap days of the objective, each with its basic
        meta / minimum objective.

OfficialContactListResponse.title: OfficialContactListResponse
OfficialContactListResponse.description: The official-contact directory (optionally filtered by category).

OfficialContactResponse.title: OfficialContactResponse
OfficialContactResponse.description: A public-agency contact from the global directory.

PasswordChangeRequest.title: PasswordChangeRequest
PasswordChangeRequest.description:
Request body for the ``PATCH /users/me/password`` endpoint.

Rotating a password requires proving ownership of the current one, so
both values are mandatory.  ``new_password`` inherits the shared
complexity policy (8–128 characters, at least one digit and one
uppercase letter).

Attributes:
    current_password: The account's existing plaintext password,
        verified against the stored hash by the service layer.
    new_password: The replacement password.

PlanLimitsResponse.title: PlanLimitsResponse
PlanLimitsResponse.description: The ceilings and features included in a plan.

PlanTier.title: PlanTier
PlanTier.description:
The user's subscription tier, used for quota and model selection.

``FREE`` is the always-available limited tier; ``TRIAL`` is the automatic
new-user trial and behaves like a small paid plan; ``STARTER``/``PRO``/
``PREMIUM`` mirror the plans sold through Google Play.  The per-plan
ceilings live in :mod:`app.clients.plan_limits` (the single source of
truth); this enum is the vocabulary callers route on.

PromotionResponse.title: PromotionResponse
PromotionResponse.description: One informational promotion card shown to a user.

ProposedActionResponse.title: ProposedActionResponse
ProposedActionResponse.description:
One action the model proposed, already validated and persisted.

``executor`` is ``"device"`` when the app must run it locally and report
the outcome back, or ``"backend"`` when the server runs it on
``POST /agents/actions/{id}/confirm``.  ``requires_confirmation`` and
``prepares_only`` are server-side policy (see
:mod:`app.schemas.agent_action_schemas`).

QuizRequest.title: QuizRequest
QuizRequest.description: Request body to generate a quiz for a deck or a free topic.

Recurrence.title: Recurrence
Recurrence.description: Simple recurrence cadence shared by tasks and reminders.

RegisterObjectiveRequest.title: RegisterObjectiveRequest
RegisterObjectiveRequest.description:
Request body for the ``POST /objectives/register`` endpoint.

Attributes:
    title: Short title for the *general* objective (2–255
        characters), e.g. "learning English".
    description: Optional longer description (up to 1000 characters).
    due_date: Deadline for the objective.  Must be a valid ISO-8601
        datetime string.

RegisterUserRequest.title: RegisterUserRequest
RegisterUserRequest.description:
Request body for the ``POST /auth/register`` endpoint.

Validates that the provided data meets minimum security requirements
before it reaches the service layer.

Attributes:
    full_name: User's display name (2–120 characters).
    email: A valid email address (validated by ``EmailStr``).
    password: Must be 8–128 characters and contain at least one
        digit and one uppercase letter (enforced by
        :class:`app.schemas.password_rules.PasswordRulesMixin`, shared
        with the password-change endpoint).
    birth_date: The user's date of birth.  Used by the age gate: anyone
        under :attr:`app.core.config.Settings.minimum_account_age_years`
        is refused with a 422 before the account is created.

ReminderCreate.title: ReminderCreate
ReminderCreate.description: Request body for creating a reminder.

ReminderResponse.title: ReminderResponse
ReminderResponse.description: Response body for a single reminder.

ReminderSnooze.title: ReminderSnooze
ReminderSnooze.description: Request body for snoozing a reminder.

ReminderUpdate.title: ReminderUpdate
ReminderUpdate.description: Request body for patching a reminder.

ReportCategory.title: ReportCategory
ReportCategory.description: Coarse category of a community report.

ReportCreate.title: ReportCreate
ReportCreate.description: Request body for creating a community report.

ReportResponse.title: ReportResponse
ReportResponse.description:
Response body for a report.

``author_id`` is ``None`` for anonymous reports (even for the author).
``confirmations`` and ``flags`` are aggregate counters; ``confirmed_by_me``
tells the caller whether they already confirmed it.

ReportStatus.title: ReportStatus
ReportStatus.description: Moderation lifecycle of a community report.

ReportUpdate.title: ReportUpdate
ReportUpdate.description: Request body for patching the caller's own report.

ReviewCreate.title: ReviewCreate
ReviewCreate.description:
Request body for reviewing a card.

``grade`` follows the SM-2 quality scale: ``0``–``2`` is a lapse,
``3``–``5`` is a successful recall (higher = easier).

RoadmapDayListResponse.title: RoadmapDayListResponse
RoadmapDayListResponse.description: Response body for listing an objective's roadmap days.

RoadmapDayResponse.title: RoadmapDayResponse
RoadmapDayResponse.description: Response body for a single roadmap day.

RoadmapDayStatus.title: RoadmapDayStatus
RoadmapDayStatus.description: Status of a single roadmap day.

status.description: Novo status do dia do roadmap

RoadmapDayStatusUpdate.title: RoadmapDayStatusUpdate
RoadmapDayStatusUpdate.description: Request body for updating a roadmap day's status.

RtdnResponse.title: RtdnResponse
RtdnResponse.description: Acknowledgement body for the Pub/Sub push endpoint.

SafetyNotice.title: SafetyNotice
SafetyNotice.description: Safety-hook outcome attached to a chat reply.

SetBrightnessAction.title: SetBrightnessAction
SetBrightnessAction.description: Set the screen brightness to a percentage.

SetVolumeAction.title: SetVolumeAction
SetVolumeAction.description: Set the volume of one audio stream to a percentage.

SettingsPanel.title: SettingsPanel
SettingsPanel.description: Which system settings panel to open.

StudyPlanCreate.title: StudyPlanCreate
StudyPlanCreate.description: Request body for creating a study plan.

StudyPlanResponse.title: StudyPlanResponse
StudyPlanResponse.description: Response body for a study plan.

StudyPlanUpdate.title: StudyPlanUpdate
StudyPlanUpdate.description: Request body for patching a study plan (all fields optional).

SubAgentResponse.title: SubAgentResponse
SubAgentResponse.description: One entry of the sub-agent catalog (``GET /sub-agents``).

SubscriptionResponse.title: SubscriptionResponse
SubscriptionResponse.description:
The authenticated user's current entitlement snapshot.

``plan`` is the *effective* tier (``free``/``trial``/``starter``/``pro``/
``premium``), which is what the client should render; ``status`` is the
raw stored subscription state and ``subscription_inactive`` tells the app
a renewal is needed.

SupportResourceResponse.title: SupportResourceResponse
SupportResourceResponse.description:
A domestic-violence support resource.

This endpoint is **read-only**: nothing a caller sends here is stored or
published.  It exists only to surface help lines.

SystemPromptListResponse.title: SystemPromptListResponse
SystemPromptListResponse.description: Response payload for listing system prompts (admin view).

SystemPromptRequest.title: SystemPromptRequest
SystemPromptRequest.description: Request payload for creating or updating a system prompt.

SystemPromptResponse.title: SystemPromptResponse
SystemPromptResponse.description:
Response payload for a system prompt record.

Includes the prompt text, so it is only ever served to administrators.

SystemPromptSummaryListResponse.title: SystemPromptSummaryListResponse
SystemPromptSummaryListResponse.description: Response payload for listing system prompts (non-admin view).

SystemPromptSummaryResponse.title: SystemPromptSummaryResponse
SystemPromptSummaryResponse.description:
Response payload for a system prompt served to a non-admin caller.

The ``system_prompt`` text is deliberately absent: these endpoints are
readable by any authenticated user, and the prompt is the agent's own
instruction set rather than data the user is meant to read.

TaskCreate.title: TaskCreate
TaskCreate.description: Request body for creating a task.

TaskResponse.title: TaskResponse
TaskResponse.description: Response body for a single task.

TaskUpdate.title: TaskUpdate
TaskUpdate.description: Request body for patching a task (all fields optional).

TodayResponse.title: TodayResponse
TodayResponse.description: A summary of the user's local day.

ToggleFlashlightAction.title: ToggleFlashlightAction
ToggleFlashlightAction.description: Turn the flashlight on or off.

TokenResponse.title: TokenResponse
TokenResponse.description: Response body returned by the refresh token endpoint.

UserAgentResponse.title: UserAgentResponse
UserAgentResponse.description:
The authenticated user's personalization profile (``GET /me/agent``).

``active_group_slugs``/``active_sub_agent_slugs`` carry the raw selected
slugs (persisted form); ``active_groups``/``active_sub_agents`` carry the
resolved catalog entries so the client does not need a second request.

UserAgentUpdate.title: UserAgentUpdate
UserAgentUpdate.description:
Request body for ``PUT /me/agent``.

Every field is optional so a single PUT can patch one attribute; the
service applies only the provided values.

UserListResponse.title: UserListResponse
UserListResponse.description: Paginated listing of users returned by ``GET /users``.

UserProfileResponse.title: UserProfileResponse
UserProfileResponse.description:
Public identity of the signed-in user.

Returned by the self-service endpoints (``PATCH /users/me``).  Unlike
:class:`UserResponse` it omits ``created_at``, so the shape matches
exactly what ``GET /auth/me`` and the login/register responses carry —
a client can therefore use it to refresh its cached profile in place.

UserProfileUpdate.title: UserProfileUpdate
UserProfileUpdate.description:
Request body for the ``PATCH /users/me`` endpoint.

Only the display name is editable.  The e-mail is deliberately
immutable here: it is both the login identifier and the unique account
key, so changing it is an identity change rather than a profile edit and
is intentionally left out of scope.

Attributes:
    full_name: The new display name (2–120 characters), matching the
        bounds enforced at registration.

VolumeStream.title: VolumeStream
VolumeStream.description: Which audio stream a volume change applies to.

WebSearchAction.title: WebSearchAction
WebSearchAction.description: Open a web search for a query.

WeeklyPlanAcceptResponse.title: WeeklyPlanAcceptResponse
WeeklyPlanAcceptResponse.description: Result of accepting a weekly plan.

WeeklyPlanRequest.title: WeeklyPlanRequest
WeeklyPlanRequest.description: Request body for generating a weekly plan.

WeeklyPlanResponse.title: WeeklyPlanResponse
WeeklyPlanResponse.description: The cached (not yet persisted) weekly-plan proposal.

WeeklyPlanSuggestion.title: WeeklyPlanSuggestion
WeeklyPlanSuggestion.description: One structured suggestion returned by the AI (not yet persisted).

WhatIsPendingTodayAction.title: WhatIsPendingTodayAction
WhatIsPendingTodayAction.description:
Answer with the roadmap items pending today.

Resolved **server-side**: the service renders the facts from the
database and the model's prose is discarded, so the answer cannot be
hallucinated.  The rendered text *is* the reply and the action is
**never returned to the client** — it is a read, not something the app
executes — so ``requires_confirmation`` stays ``False`` and there is
nothing to confirm.  It exists in the whitelist only so the model may
still ask for it.

app__schemas__user_schemas__UserResponse.title: UserResponse
app__schemas__user_schemas__UserResponse.description: Public user representation returned by admin endpoints.
